description: Sealed relay reservations (relay-seal.v1) and multi-hop carried sessions (relay-multihop.v1) of section 14.10.

relaySealRejected.name: invalidSessionIdLength
relaySealRejected.description: sessionId shorter than 16 bytes must be rejected with E_PAL3_RELAY_INVALID.

relaySealRejected.name: relayPinMismatch
relaySealRejected.description: Relay hybrid identity digest does not match pinned relay.

relaySealRejected.name: blindClientIdWrongNonce
relaySealRejected.description: Wrong rClient blinding nonce fails constant-time blindClientId verification.

relaySealRejected.name: clientIdentityMismatch
relaySealRejected.description: clientIdentityDigest does not match the expected pal hybrid identity.

relaySealRejected.name: issuedTooFarInFuture
relaySealRejected.description: issuedAtMs more than 300,000 ms in the future must be rejected.

relaySealRejected.name: expiredReservation
relaySealRejected.description: Reservation at or past expiresAtMs must be rejected.

relaySealRejected.name: tamperedEd25519Signature
relaySealRejected.description: Strict-AND: bit flip in Ed25519 signature must fail.

relaySealRejected.name: tamperedMldsa65Signature
relaySealRejected.description: Strict-AND: bit flip in ML-DSA-65 signature must fail.

relaySealRejected.name: relayTokenTampered
relaySealRejected.description: Tampered relayToken AEAD tag must be rejected on relay presentation.

relaySealRejected.name: relayTokenWrongSessionBinding
relaySealRejected.description: Presenting relayToken under a different sessionId fails AAD binding.

relaySealRejected.name: relayTokenExpired
relaySealRejected.description: Presenting a valid relayToken at or after expiresAtMs fails with E_PAL3_RELAY_EXPIRED.

relayMultihopRejected.name: notEnabledByOptIn
relayMultihopRejected.description: Multi-hop carried sessions require explicit opt-in and are never enabled by default.

relayMultihopRejected.name: mismatchedByteLength
relayMultihopRejected.description: Frame whose byte length does not equal 27 + payload_len must be dropped.

relayMultihopRejected.name: duplicateSequence
relayMultihopRejected.description: Duplicate sequence number on the same leg must be dropped with E_PAL3_RELAY_REPLAY.

relayMultihopRejected.name: belowReplayWindow
relayMultihopRejected.description: Sequence number below the 64-entry sliding replay window (highest 64 -> floor 1) must be dropped with E_PAL3_RELAY_REPLAY.
